komendy.opisEn: Adopts an existing project into the RelAI structure: a full backup as the gate, analysis of the code and history, documents generated from the existing state and a change report with a tested full rollback.
Reports on the state of the project documentation — housekeeping and health — and ends with a list of proposals to approve; changes nothing by itself.
Packs the project into a ZIP archive in the central backup folder, without secrets and runtime folders, and writes a journal entry.
Opens a branch — a side thread from a stage gets its own branch card and a self-contained prompt for a fresh session, without touching the frozen plan.
komendy.opisPl: Odłóż boczny wątek na osobną kartę

komendy.opisEn: Distils the project journal into a list of changes — on screen, and into a file only on request.
Shows a report of working artifacts grouped by source, with the protected ones and the reason for protection; deletes only after a yes for each group and writes a journal entry.

Crew — the model that ran the command becomes the orchestrator of one goal: an interview about roles and models, waves without file conflicts, delegation to host subagents or to a second tool (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor), cross review and a closing ritual; without a second signed-in tool it falls back to basic mode.
Assembles a project handover package in one HTML file — state, document map, plans and stages, open risks, where to start.
komendy.opisPl: Cały projekt w jednym pliku HTML

komendy.opisEn: Shows the project cheat sheet — commands, phrases and automatic behaviours — by presenting docs/KOMENDY.md.

Rewrites text so it loses AI writing habits without changing what it says — shows the original next to the rewrite, lists the removed patterns, checks that numbers, dates, links and code survived, and changes a file only after a yes.
komendy.opisPl: Usuń z tekstu nawyki pisarskie AI

komendy.opisEn: Refreshes the tool model list in the project — asks for consent to network traffic on every run, reads the vendor documentation or asks the person, shows the old and new list side by side and saves only after confirmation.
Turns a dictated sentence into a precise prompt — shows the original next to the proposal, marks every addition and waits for approval; executes nothing.
Starts a stage of the active RelAI plan — detects the plan and the next stage, shows the start card and waits for consent.
Walks through the project using only its documents — state, map, plans, risks, where to start.
komendy.opisPl: Opowieść o projekcie z jego dokumentów

komendy.opisEn: Updates a RelAI project to the version of the installed plugin — shows the differences, changes only with consent, respects local overrides and ends with a journal entry.
